g.text: SD00 — Run an LLM Task (Template Method, Strategy, Adapter)
referenced by SD01, SD02, SD06, SD07, SD09
(n1) task is any LlmTask subclass, e.g. ActionInterpreter. It is entered from the subclass's public method (interpret(),
narrate(), reply(), generate(), write(), summarize()), which calls run(input). run() is the template method;
buildPrompt, parse, isValid and fallback are supplied by the subclass.
(n2) llm is the LLMClient strategy, here bound to DeepSeekClient (GroqClient works the same way)
(n3) focus = what the prompt is about (the NPC's id, the current location's id, ...): fixed facts and summaries that mention
(n4) deterministic fallback, e.g. OfflineFallbackParser, template text or a pre-written NPC line; run() sets fallbackUsed =
